pl-l4d2c2-d1e115.summary: Turns to the sacrament of baptism, the first among the sacraments of new grace.
claims: Baptism is the first of the new sacraments.

pl-l4d2c2-d1e118.summary: States that John foreshadowed Christ's baptism with his own; he was the first recorded to baptize, but in water, not in the Spirit, as he said, 'I baptize you in water for repentance'. He washed bodies only and did not cleanse from sins.
claims: John baptized in water, not in the Spirit.
John's baptism did not cleanse from sin.

pl-l4d2c2.summary: Turns to baptism, the first of the sacraments of new grace. John foreshadowed Christ's baptism with his own; he was the first to baptize, but in water, not in the Spirit, washing bodies only and not cleansing from sins.
claims: Baptism is the first of the sacraments of the new law.
John's baptism washed the body but did not cleanse from sin.
